project.name: RAG Dashboard
project.purpose: Machine-readable index of reusable repo surfaces and capabilities for humans, AI agents, and tooling.

status_legend.canonical: Preferred active surface for new work or discovery.
status_legend.legacy: Still present or active, but not the preferred surface when a newer canonical path exists.
status_legend.internal-only: Useful for maintainers or tooling, but not intended as a primary external surface.
status_legend.supporting: Important supporting surface such as docs, scripts, templates, or optional infrastructure.

update_when: A major service, shared package, config entrypoint, important script, or key doc is added, removed, renamed, or cut over.
Routing ownership changes between Vite proxy, Go gateway, Node orchestrator, Python legacy, retrieval-service, or Go WebSocket.
A surface changes lifecycle status between canonical, legacy, internal-only, or supporting.
authoring_rules: Prefer updating an existing resource entry over adding aliases for the same responsibility.
If an older surface remains runtime-active but is no longer preferred, mark it legacy instead of canonical.
Keep executable config ownership attached to real code paths such as config loaders, proxy maps, and compose files.
Populate notable_exports for key reusable code surfaces so humans and AI can find callable entrypoints without grepping blindly.
Run npm run check:resource-index after editing this manifest, docs/project-resource-index.md, or the README reuse-first entry section.

notes: Current dev routing split: /api/agent goes directly to Node on 3001, /api/v1 goes directly to retrieval-service on 8002, /api plus /health plus /metrics go to the Go gateway on 8080, and /ws goes to the Go WebSocket gateway on 8081.
Canonical search routing is Go gateway -> retrieval-service for /api/search; Python legacy is not the canonical search backend.

connections.note: Direct in dev until the gateway fully owns that prefix.
Direct in dev per current Vite config.
WebSocketManager and related services push realtime updates through the Go WS gateway.

resources.name: Go API Gateway
resources.purpose: Canonical HTTP ingress and reverse proxy across backend services.
usage_cues: Add new frontend-visible API prefixes to internal/gateway/proxy.go:getRouteMapping().
Gateway runtime values now flow through src/backend/go-services/config/runtime.go with precedence embedded defaults -> optional JSON config file -> env -> CLI.

resources.name: Go WebSocket Gateway
resources.purpose: Canonical realtime fan-out gateway for browser websocket clients.
usage_cues: Frontend /ws traffic is proxied here in dev.
Node-side broadcast clients send updates to this gateway rather than speaking websocket directly to the browser.
WebSocket port, upgrader buffer sizes, and origin policy are centralized in src/backend/go-services/config/runtime.go.

resources.name: Node Orchestrator
resources.purpose: Fastify/XState runtime for sessions, agent orchestration, auth, and pipeline coordination.
usage_cues: Startup/runtime defaults now live in src/backend/server/config/default.json and are resolved through src/backend/server/src/config/runtime.ts using config + dotenv + commander.
Frontend reaches many Node routes through the Go gateway, but /api/agent is still direct in Vite dev.

resources.name: Node runtime config
resources.purpose: Canonical Node startup/runtime config resolver with precedence default.json -> environment -> CLI, including auth bootstrap, websocket public URL, startup-path service connectivity, queue settings, pipeline settings, recursion thresholds, logging, telemetry, database helper settings, Neo4j/Elasticsearch settings, embeddings, retrieval module defaults, cascade retrieval flags/weights, OCR defaults, storage helper settings, persistence enablement, expert-judgment settings, request-path LLM behavior, agent helper behavior, and dev/prod runtime mode.
key_commands: cd src/backend/server && npx vitest run src/__tests__/runtime-config.test.ts
usage_cues: Add new Node startup/runtime values here instead of parsing process.env ad hoc in entrypoints or services.
AuthService bootstrap now consumes runtimeConfig.auth so default admin password fallback no longer lives in code.
CacheService, TaskQueueService, PipelineService, WebSocketManager, and RecursionController startup values now enter through runtimeConfig instead of class-local env fallbacks.
Main-entry LLM key resolution and dev-only error detail exposure now read runtimeConfig instead of process.env directly.
modules/agent/src/tools.ts now reads shared runtimeConfig instead of helper-local env fallbacks.
LoggerService and telemetry.ts now read shared runtimeConfig instead of helper-local env fallbacks.

modules/llm/src/index.ts, modules/retrieval/src/index.ts, modules/ocr/src/index.ts, modules/storage/src/index.ts, tools/index.ts, and PostgresPersistenceService.ts now read shared runtimeConfig instead of module-local env fallbacks.

modules/retrieval/src/cascade-retrieval.ts now reads shared runtimeConfig for Qdrant, Neo4j, Elasticsearch, PostgreSQL, collection/index defaults, and cascade enable flags/weights instead of helper-local env fallbacks.
Repo-root .env is loaded through bootstrap-env.ts without overriding already-exported environment variables.

resources.name: Retrieval Service
resources.purpose: Canonical retrieval, rerank, evaluation, and RAG agent backend.
usage_cues: Owns /api/search through the Go gateway and most /api/v1/* retrieval endpoints.
Provides /api/v1/architecture/live, which powers scripts/sync_arch_docs.py.
Startup/API runtime values now centralize in src/backend/retrieval-service/app/runtime_config.py instead of per-module env parsing.
Guide-agent runtime adjustments now persist through PostgreSQL runtime_config_overrides instead of process env mutation.

resources.name: Python Legacy API
resources.purpose: Legacy FastAPI backend still used for embedding, ingestion, and some stats/document routes.
usage_cues: Still serves /api/v1/embedding, /api/v1/documents, /api/stats, and /api/v1/stats.
Do not treat it as the canonical /api/search backend; search now routes to retrieval-service.
LLM/API/startup defaults for this legacy service now centralize in src/backend/python-legacy/config/runtime.py.

resources.name: OCR Service
resources.purpose: Standalone OCR microservice for PDFs and images.
usage_cues: Go gateway exposes this service at /api/ocr.
Output directories are controlled by OCR_OUTPUT_DIR and related environment variables.

resources.name: Web Frontend
resources.purpose: Canonical browser UI for chat, operations, and learning workflows.
usage_cues: Proxy behavior lives in vite.config.ts and is part of the runtime topology.
Uses @rag/shared via dist when available and falls back to packages/shared/src in dev.
Build-time env-backed frontend runtime values are centralized in src/frontend/web/src/config/runtime.ts.

resources.name: @rag/shared
resources.purpose: Canonical shared TypeScript package consumed by the web frontend and Node orchestrator.
usage_cues: Build this package before compiling server or web when dist artifacts are required.
Vite dev can resolve packages/shared/src directly if dist has not been built yet.

resources.name: Root package.json workspace hub
resources.purpose: Canonical JS/TS workspace command hub and top-level cross-stack script entrypoint.
usage_cues: Workspaces include packages/*, src/frontend/*, src/backend/server, and src/backend/ocr-service.
Root test shortcuts call Node tests and Python legacy pytest from one place.
Resource-index anti-drift checks run here through ajv-cli plus remark-validate-links.

resources.name: Root pyproject.toml
resources.purpose: Canonical root Python dependency and style configuration for repo Python code.
usage_cues: Defines Black and Ruff line length 100 and mypy strict mode.
Applies to the root Python project; retrieval-service and OCR service also keep service-local requirements files.

resources.name: Canonical Python config loader
resources.purpose: Canonical typed runtime configuration loader for Python services and scripts.
usage_cues: Prefer get_config() and reload_config() here over ad hoc config parsing.
Precedence inside the loader is RAG__SECTION__KEY env -> config/.env -> config/config.yaml -> code defaults.

resources.name: Legacy Python settings module
resources.purpose: Older AppConfig loader that coexists with the canonical config loader.
usage_cues: Prefer config/loader.py for new config work and executable config ownership.
Keep this status updated if the older loader is removed or fully cut over.

resources.name: Retrieval-service runtime config
resources.purpose: Canonical retrieval-service runtime config accessor for repo-root .env bootstrap, localhost proxy sanitization, and runtime settings across startup/API/helper layers such as PostgreSQL, Redis, Qdrant, OCR, Elasticsearch, TEI, service health URLs, learning artifact paths, OCR output directories, eval/report/trace paths, hybrid tuning, embedding backend flags, model cache paths, and pipeline directories.
key_commands: cd src/backend/retrieval-service && python -m pytest tests/test_runtime_config.py tests/test_embedding_service.py tests/test_signal_collector.py tests/test_price_query_text_fallback.py tests/test_fee_rate_calculation_flow.py tests/test_learning_runs_unified_api.py -q
usage_cues: Import read_runtime_config(), postgres_connection_kwargs(), redis_connection_kwargs(), or resolve_local_model_path() instead of reading DATABASE_URL, POSTGRES_*, PG_*, REDIS_*, QDRANT_*, OCR_SERVICE_URL, TEI_URL, ES_*, service URL envs, learning artifact paths, OCR output paths, hybrid tuning envs, tracing dirs, or model cache paths directly in retrieval-service runtime code.
Pair this accessor with app/runtime_overrides.py when a retrieval-service runtime value is operator-adjustable at runtime.

resources.name: Retrieval-service runtime overrides
resources.purpose: Canonical executable runtime override surface for guide-agent adjustments such as top_k, score_threshold, rerank_enabled, keyword backend, and vector backend, backed by runtime_config_overrides plus runtime_config_audit.
key_commands: cd src/backend/retrieval-service && python -m pytest tests/test_vector_search_backend.py tests/test_hybrid_search_backend.py -q
usage_cues: Use get_runtime_override() in retrieval-service readers instead of reading RAG_* / KEYWORD_BACKEND / VECTOR_BACKEND process env variables directly.
Use apply_runtime_override() from guide control paths so changes leave both a current-state row and an audit trail.

resources.name: Python-legacy runtime config
resources.purpose: Canonical runtime accessor for python-legacy API/service/helper/tool defaults such as API host/port, enhanced/simple API ports, logging level, CORS origins, OCR/knowledge-base paths, database and search-store connectivity, embedding/rerank model names and local paths, model cache roots, query-analysis flags, llama.cpp paths, vLLM URL/model, and OpenAI-compatible API settings.
usage_cues: Import read_runtime_config(), tool_pg_config(), or tool_pg_database() instead of reading API_HOST, API_PORT, ENHANCED_API_PORT, SIMPLE_LLM_PORT, LOG_LEVEL, CORS_ORIGINS, RAG_API, OCR_API, OCR_OUTPUT_DIR, KB_DIR, ENABLE_QUERY_ANALYSIS, ES_*, NEO4J_*, LLAMA_CPP_PATH, VLLM_API_URL, LLM_BASE_URL, OPENAI_API_BASE, POSTGRES_*, PG_*, REDIS_*, QDRANT_*, TEI_URL, MODELS_DIR, SENTENCE_TRANSFORMERS_HOME, HF_HOME, RERANK_MODEL_NAME, RERANK_BATCH_SIZE, or RERANK_MODEL_PATH directly in python-legacy runtime code.
Constructor arguments and request-time inputs should still win over runtime config when a caller passes explicit values.

resources.name: Default Python runtime config
resources.purpose: Default structured runtime values consumed by config/loader.py.
usage_cues: Edit this file for repo-default values; environment variables override it.
Keep keys aligned with the config classes in config/loader.py.

resources.name: Environment template
resources.purpose: Non-secret local setup template for environment-driven configuration.
usage_cues: Use as a starting point for a repo-root .env during local development.
Do not commit real secrets.

resources.name: Frontend runtime config
resources.purpose: Canonical frontend runtime config resolver for Vite env-backed API base URLs, WebSocket URLs, reconnect timing, active provider selection, provider endpoints/keys, and frontend retrieval request defaults.
usage_cues: Import getApiBaseUrl() and resolveWebSocketUrl() instead of reading import.meta.env directly in services, hooks, or components.
Use frontendRuntimeConfig.activeProvider and provider settings to keep UI/runtime defaults centralized.

resources.name: Frontend Vite proxy config
resources.purpose: Canonical frontend dev proxy and @rag/shared alias configuration.
usage_cues: Current dev split is /api/agent -> 3001, /api/v1 -> 8002, /api -> 8080, and /ws -> 8081.
If frontend routing is unclear, check this file before changing API calls.

resources.name: Go gateway runtime config
resources.purpose: Canonical Go runtime config loader for gateway service connectivity, telemetry, aggregated-health timeout, websocket startup settings, and CLI/env/config-file precedence.
usage_cues: Use GO_SERVICES_CONFIG_FILE or --config for JSON overlays, then env, then CLI flags for final runtime values.
Gateway and websocket startup values, OTEL endpoint/service name, service URLs/timeouts, and websocket upgrader settings are normalized here before the binaries start.

resources.name: Go gateway route map
resources.purpose: Canonical HTTP prefix-to-service mapping for externally reachable backend routes.
usage_cues: Register new externally reachable API prefixes in getRouteMapping().
Current canonical search path is /api/search -> retrieval service, not Python legacy.

resources.name: Node custom env bootstrap
resources.purpose: Internal Node bootstrap that manually loads the repo-root .env before telemetry starts.
usage_cues: Only sets environment variables that are currently undefined.
Must run from src/backend/server or the relative .env path may resolve incorrectly.

resources.name: start-all.sh
resources.purpose: Primary convenience script for starting the local stack or docker-compose stack.
usage_cues: Local mode checks infrastructure ports and starts Python legacy, retrieval-service, Node, Go WebSocket, and Go gateway if needed.
Docker mode delegates to docker-compose up -d.

resources.name: stop-all.sh
resources.purpose: Primary convenience script for stopping the local stack or docker-compose stack.
usage_cues: Local mode stops services bound to ports 8080, 8081, 3001, 8002, and 8000.
Docker mode delegates to docker-compose down.

resources.name: topology_health.py
resources.purpose: Machine-readable topology and runtime invariant checker.
usage_cues: Uses DATABASE_URL or a localhost PostgreSQL default DSN.
Useful when checking closed-loop topology, feedback reachability, and evidence integrity.

resources.name: check-governance.py
resources.purpose: Repository governance scanner for config-code consistency, orphaned files, and related rules.
usage_cues: Includes a check that config/config.yaml keys line up with config/loader.py.
Treat as a supporting audit surface rather than the runtime source of truth.

resources.name: sync_arch_docs.py
resources.purpose: Syncs architecture summary blocks from the live retrieval endpoint into marked docs.
usage_cues: Reads /api/v1/architecture/live from retrieval-service by default.
Currently patches marker blocks in AGENTS.md.

resources.name: index_system_kb.py
resources.purpose: Indexes docs/rag-system-internals content into the rag_system_kb vector collection.
usage_cues: Uses TEI_URL and QDRANT_URL, defaulting to localhost services.
Feeds the curated system knowledge base from docs/rag-system-internals.

resources.name: index_self_docs.py
resources.purpose: Indexes selected repo docs into the rag_self_docs vector collection.
usage_cues: Indexes selected top-level docs, docs/**, .kimi/*.md, and selected .agent markdown files.
Excludes large/generated trees such as node_modules and qdrant_storage.

resources.name: Main docker-compose stack
resources.purpose: Primary compose stack for core infrastructure and application services.
usage_cues: Defines Postgres, Redis, Qdrant, Elasticsearch, Neo4j, application services, and an opt-in Milvus profile.
Use this as the main compose source of truth for local full-stack deployment.

resources.name: Langfuse observability compose stack
resources.purpose: Optional compose stack for observability and trace review.
usage_cues: Runs a separate Langfuse Postgres and UI stack.
Keep secrets and public URLs environment-appropriate before using outside local development.

resources.name: Architecture overview
resources.purpose: High-level system architecture, service roles, and request-chain reference.
usage_cues: Good first stop for service/port orientation across the monorepo.
Human-readable reference only; executable routing truth still lives in Vite and Go gateway config.

resources.name: Agent runtime internals
resources.purpose: Explains the ReAct loop, XState runtime, shared channel state, and trace expectations.
usage_cues: Use when modifying agent lifecycle, iteration limits, or runtime state handling.
Pairs well with the Node orchestrator and LangGraph reference surfaces.

resources.name: System config guide
resources.purpose: Human-readable explanation of major config knobs, defaults, and tuning guidance.
usage_cues: Use for context and parameter explanations.
Executable config ownership still belongs to config/loader.py, config/config.yaml, and environment variables.

resources.name: Usage guide
resources.purpose: End-user and operator usage patterns for querying, calculations, and troubleshooting insufficient answers.
usage_cues: Helpful when mapping UI capabilities to expected user workflows.
Also useful for support tooling that needs capability summaries.

resources.name: Four-database tools specification
resources.purpose: Tool-contract reference for vector, keyword, graph, structured, and calculator retrieval tools.
usage_cues: Treat required fields such as chunk_id, doc_id, page_number, and source_db as contract cues for retrieval outputs.
Useful when aligning tool results across AI agents and backend services.

resources.name: Frontend-backend integration analysis
resources.purpose: Detailed routing and dependency analysis for frontend/backend integration work.
usage_cues: Use when debugging proxy alignment or gateway ownership questions.
Cross-check current code before assuming every recommendation in the report is still current.

resources.name: LangGraph runtime reference
resources.purpose: Reference mental model for channels, checkpoints, and runtime loops used by agent work in this repo.
usage_cues: Useful when comparing LangGraph concepts to the Node/XState runtime context model.
Reference material, not an executable source of truth.
